title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: Ranking of Grounds Decided on Registration
content:
Some grounds for rejecting a notice under `Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims` can be settled from the moment the notice is registered. Where more than one of them holds, the reason recorded is fixed by rank.

## Statement

The reason recorded is the highest-ranked ground that holds:

| Rank | Ground | Reason recorded |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | amount below the tier's minimum claim | below the minimum claim |
| 2 | kind of loss not covered, or temperature damage below the minimum reefer rank | not covered by the tier |
| 3 | notice dated after the time bar date | time barred |
| 4 | notice dated after the last day of its notice window | notice out of time |

Where none of the four holds, the notice is not rejected on these grounds.

## Why these grounds are decided on registration

Each of the four is settled by the cover, the notice and the reefer service of the named container alone, and no claim document can take it away. A notice meeting one of them is therefore rejected as soon as it is registered. All four rank above the grounds of a missing logged excursion, misdeclared cargo, an excluded peril and documents not submitted.

## Combinations (hypothetical)

| Grounds that hold | Reason recorded |
|---|---|
| below minimum and out of time | below the minimum claim |
| not covered and time barred | not covered by the tier |
| time barred and out of time | time barred |
| out of time only | notice out of time |
| none | no rejection on these grounds |
